Regulation O has not been comprehensively updated since 1979.

The proposal updates dollar-based thresholds and indexes them to economic growth going forward.

The rules governing these banks were first established in 1993.

They have not been updated and have proven over time to be overly burdensome and complex.

"Today's proposal is another important step in our work to modernize the bank regulatory framework by updating mutual bank regulations for the first time in 30 years.

The continued success of this model contributes to the institutional diversity of the U.S. banking system, which is one of the greatest strengths of our financial system," said Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle W.
